mode_certificate.champion_limitation: The champion passively interprets inherited and arriving evidence but has no authority for an action to become an identifiable causal intervention.
mode_certificate.not_local_refinement: This introduces active evidence creation and a runtime causal-control transition absent from the static champion edge and tested frontier, rather than refining review, serialization, exclusion, or causal-basis reset.
mode_certificate.observable_effect: When the trigger occurs, control changes despite unchanged inherited evidence, and subsequent behavior changes only through the observable consequence attributable to the intervention.
mode_certificate.state_transition: The single emitted policy moves from observation-conditioned control to intervention-attributed control, treating an admissible action as the cause under test and its ensuing relevant observation as authoritative causal evidence.
mode_certificate.trigger: Post-deployment admissible observations expose decision-relevant causal ambiguity while the current task state permits an obligation-preserving action with an observable discriminating consequence.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Add evidence-triggered causal-intervention authority to the sole analysis-to-policy edge so the single emitted policy can transition from observation-conditioned control to intervention-attributed control while retaining the champion's exclusions and open visibility.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: Decision-relevant uncertainty can be resolved through causally attributable evidence instead of prolonged passive observation, enabling task-general adaptation within one valid policy lineage.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The champion can exclude unsupported commitments before construction but cannot authorize the emitted policy to create causally attributable evidence when later observations leave a decision-relevant cause unresolved.

structural_mutation.after: The edge retains those exclusions while binding an evidence condition that transfers the emitted policy into intervention-attributed control, where an obligation-preserving action can make subsequent admissible evidence causally informative.
structural_mutation.before: The edge carries binding negative exclusions, and the emitted policy can react only to evidence arriving independently of its own control choices.
structural_mutation.factor: evidence-triggered causal-intervention authority on the sole analysis-to-policy edge
structural_mutation.why_structural: The mutation changes edge authority, evidence timing, and runtime control-state semantics without adding calls, parallel paths, or terminal role fission.
